points.text: The U.S. military moved aircraft from a second British airbase after a threat linked to Iran, following an earlier bomber withdrawal from RAF Fairford.

House Republicans elected Jim Jordan as their next-congress leader and voted to block an impeachment effort against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

Researchers expect global fossil fuel emissions to fall slightly in 2026, citing renewable energy growth and an oil-price shock linked to the Iran war.
